crossRefs.note: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord…
From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at…
While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and…

translations.web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
translations.bsb: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
translations.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
translations.asv: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?
